about: Get a licence to run a recruitment, mediation or temporary employment agency.
note: Requirements read from the official MOHRE service page on the checked date. Field labels sit behind sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Applicant and relatives up to second degree must not be Ministry employees
Needs a clear business address unless electronic recruitment is allowed
Applicant must not own or partner in a firm closed for labour violations
No listed criminal convictions unless rehabilitated or a year has passed after a fine
Bank guarantee or insurance: 300,000 AED for mediation, 1,000,000 AED for temporary employment
documents: Initial approval from the Department of Economic Development
Licensee's passport and Emirates ID copies
Certificate of financial solvency and property report
fees: Tax and collection charges are extra
